title: Mystic Dominican Mermaid
description: A woman with long flowing black hair, wearing a bikini patterned with the Dominican Republic flag, sits on a large ornate palm tree trunk extending over a tropical beach. She is covered in tribal tattoos and looks upward toward a glowing cosmic mandala portal in a vibrant starry night sky filled with purple and turquoise nebulae.
prompt: A beautiful Dominican woman with long flowing black hair and tribal tattoos sits on a massive carved palm tree trunk leaning over a tropical beach at night. She wears a bikini with the Dominican Republic flag. Her body is turned toward the viewer while she gazes up at a large glowing circular mandala portal with red white and blue rings floating in a vibrant purple and turquoise starry nebula sky. Crystals float in the air, ocean waves lap the shore, distant mountains visible, highly detailed fantasy scene
